name: Beyond the Yellow Line
source:
A train ride with an unexpected delay.

Two strangers sitting face to face.

One is one step away from death.

One is one step away from murder.

Which one will cross the line?

[From [url=https://dekaloop-studio.itch.io/beyond-the-yellow-line]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一趟意外延误的列车旅程。

相对而坐的两名陌生人。

一人距离死亡仅一步之遥。

一人距离行凶仅一步之遥。

究竟谁会迈过那条黄线？

[摘自[url=https://dekaloop-studio.itch.io/beyond-the-yellow-line]itch.io[/url]]
